The viewer is the owner and reads here as a reviewer, so every event arrives open at detail and its provenance stays folded. One event in each picture also shows its provenance open, as the fully drawn example, and the last tabloio pin shows its subproject events open. An observer arrives at glance, with every event closed; the owner with no role set arrives at provenance, with every block open.

Both pictures run oldest first. The status after each event is a replay, so each line builds on the one above it, and a reviewer starts where the last review ends. VIEWS.md and SYNTAX.md write their examples in the same order.

One line holds the events one commit makes on one task, so a commit that both records a status and carries its Reviewed: trailer reads status, reviewed. The counts above each list still count events.

Gates: ❔ undefined, 📝 defined, 🔧 function, 📐 design. States: ⚪ undefined, 🟢 nominal. Reason: 👓 review, the hand-off to the reviewer. Each symbol comes from .tableaux/gates.yaml; the gate definition explains every one. An event kind has no symbol.
